company.name: Arada
company.shortDescription: Arada is a property development company that focuses on creating communities and living spaces.
company.description: Arada operates as a property development company that designs, develops, and delivers residential, commercial, hospitality, and mixed-use real estate projects. It manages the full cycle from land acquisition and master planning to construction, sales, and facility handover. The company also undertakes brand partnerships for hotel and resort residences and integrates community-based amenities and infrastructure into its developments. In parallel, it handles marketing, sales networks, and property management. The portfolio spans multiple thematic districts and community precincts built around lifestyle, connectivity, and mixed-use interaction.
founders: Sheikh Sultan bin Ahmed Al Qasimi
